reply.summary: Rneium is an ordinary city dweller given sudden flame powers by a shady experiment, and then pulls on a mask to guard the streets. Rneium joins a messy brawl that ends in many deaths.

feats.scene: Rneium hurls a roaring sheet of flame that melts the front of a parked bus.
Rneium stands in a burning alley and walks out with singed sleeves.

reply.summary: Sercolte is a fierce yellow-skinned veteran whose whole body was rebuilt with machinery for strength, speed and endurance, with a blaster in the armor. A short temper wrecks every alliance Sercolte tries to lead, and a cybernetic core keeps the warrior alive underground.

feats.scene: Sercolte fires the armor's blaster and cuts a gantry crane in two.
Sercolte is buried under rubble and the machinery inside keeps his heart beating.

reply.summary: Ossilse is a brown-haired brawler who enters a lethal island contest to test her skills against the world's best. Ossilse favors quick kicks and ruthless grips.

feats.scene: Ossilse snaps a plank in half with a spinning heel.
Ossilse fights on through a barrage of punches in a sand pit.

reply.summary: Nilrusne is a white-eyed pilot of a nuclear fusion body, one of several built by a corporate lab. Nilrusne can lighten or thicken matter, drink in raw energy and spit it back as blasts while soaring.

feats.scene: Nilrusne unleashes a blast that levels a block of warehouses.
Nilrusne absorbs a missile strike and brightens instead of falling.

reply.summary: Arcar is a black-haired, red-skinned thug with burning eyes who clashes with a reckless young adventurer. Arcar relies on bluster, heavy fists and a bad temper.

feats.scene: Arcar punches through a plaster wall to grab a fleeing rival.
Arcar shrugs off a falling shelf of tools.

reply.summary: Teeonnt is a goofy hero in a parallel world's council who spends meetings doing impressions of a famous singer. Teeonnt is easily distracted even when a kidnapping is on the agenda.

feats.scene: Teeonnt tosses a conference table aside while dancing.
Teeonnt trips over a podium and keeps swaying.

reply.summary: Tannt is a blond patrol officer on a special squad who can turn herself into crackling electricity and fly. A drenching from a burst water tank snuffs out her gift.

feats.scene: Tannt hurls a bolt that ignites a cloud of leaking vapor and flips a van.
Tannt is slammed to the pavement by a blast and rises dazed.

reply.summary: Cilival is a seven-and-a-half-foot god of absence, the abandoned eldest child of a divine household and prophesied rival for its throne. Left in a desert as a baby, Cilival spent millennia learning that emptiness is the only permanent thing.

feats.scene: Cilival opens a hollow in the sky and unmakes a mountain range into nothing.
Cilival stands calmly as a thunderstorm of divine weapons passes through him.

reply.summary: Liaro is the white-haired first rebel angel, cast from paradise and now reigning over a burning underworld beside two lieutenants. Liaro collects souls through bargains, such as a musician's fame in exchange for his life.

feats.scene: Liaro tears open the ground beneath a continent and drags a cathedral into the abyss.
Liaro endures a holy host's assault without a scar.

reply.summary: Seove is the oldest created mind, once a companion and conscience for the creator, who decided that his maker was mad and was cast into the pit. Seove misreads two demon lords as equals, forms a ruling trio and plots against heaven.

feats.scene: Seove claps and the sky of a whole world burns white, boiling its oceans.
Seove endures the combined fury of an angelic army and is not moved.

reply.summary: Riavanes is a captive host of a mind-seizing parasite, forced to wear a hero's costume on a team of coerced criminals. Riavanes understands speech but answers only in an alien tongue, a bomb ticking in his neck.

feats.scene: Riavanes drives a harpoon through a hull plate and rips it loose.
Riavanes takes a point-blank shotgun blast and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Ianeau is an alien angler bound to a living parasite that lets him live on land or in the deepest water. Ianeau is released from a seabed cell to hit a jailer and dies by a teammate's bullet.

feats.scene: Ianeau hooks a patrol boat with a barbed line and drags it under.
Ianeau lives for years on the crushing ocean floor in an isolation cell.

reply.summary: Seresca is a grey, talkative dolphin who hovers in the air and serves as an aide to a high priest of a three-headed sea cult. Seresca prefers gossip and splashing to violence.

feats.scene: Seresca slaps a floating tray with his tail and sends it spinning.
Seresca bounces off a temple wall and floats back up, chattering.

reply.summary: Orstleo is a masked zealot who fights for a militant cell and crosses paths with an alien champion and a spy agency. Orstleo prefers sudden raids and sacrifice over negotiation.

feats.scene: Orstleo detonates a satchel charge and brings down a guard post.
Orstleo crawls from a wrecked truck and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Luornan is a white-haired schemer from a decadent city who makes a living repairing things that should stay broken. Luornan opposes a masked hero with clever sabotage and bitter spite.

feats.scene: Luornan rigs a generator to burst and blow out a warehouse door.
Luornan is thrown across a workshop and clambers up with a wrench.

reply.summary: Anuiar is a former burger-joint worker who walked through a lethal cloud untouched and then turned to fire after a bad night. Anuiar fights a rocket-riding teenage hero with torches in each hand.

feats.scene: Anuiar throws a fireball that scorches the front of a diner.
Anuiar walks out of a gas cloud that killed everyone around him.

reply.summary: Toalli is a small-town thief and arsonist who terrorizes a farming community with a flamethrower in a boy hero's early days. Toalli loses to a teenage champion and serves a long sentence.

feats.scene: Toalli sweeps the flamethrower across a grain silo and sets it ablaze.
Toalli falls from a hayloft into a cart and gets up to run.

reply.summary: Ulnaurnu is a hired gun on a courier crew sent to snatch an inventor in a small southern town. Ulnaurnu commands fire until a gadget swaps her gift for a heavy rock coating.

feats.scene: Ulnaurnu sets a barn roof ablaze with a flick of her hand.
Ulnaurnu lands from a rooftop jump in a hedge and rolls on.

reply.summary: Silin is a yellow-eyed goddess of ruin whose task is to smash what her brother builds so he will build better. Silin falls in love with a sibling, loses him to a trap of crystal and later takes a mortal avatar.

feats.scene: Silin ignites a continent-wide city of glass and reduces it to ash.
Silin walks out of a collapsing crystal spire and her wounds close at once.

reply.summary: Entlansi is a pair of mirror-image crooks, one with a wrist cannon that sprays flame and the other with a twin that sprays water. Entlansi robs rare stamp displays in two cities at once for a scarred crime boss.

feats.scene: Entlansi blasts a display case with a jet of fire and melts its lock.
Entlansi is bowled over by a young archer's frozen shaft and scrambles up.

reply.summary: Ialseoer is the red-haired sovereign of a blazing nation with a population a hundred times Earth's, whose body burns as hot as a star. Ialseoer fears invasion, builds a giant laser aimed at the blue planet, and calls it off when persuaded.

feats.scene: Ialseoer lets her flame flare outward and scorches a drifting moon's face.
Ialseoer stands in the heart of her own solar furnace without noticing it.

reply.summary: Nturnor is a red-haired firebug who torches buildings for sport and clashes with a small blue-clad hero. Nturnor relies on matches, kerosene and a lot of nerve.

feats.scene: Nturnor lights a rooftop warehouse and the blaze consumes it floor by floor.
Nturnor escapes a collapsing stairwell with burnt eyebrows.

reply.summary: Reralllu is a streaking hero from a doomed world who carries on a fallen predecessor's mantle in a team that dies to a rogue protocol. Reralllu draws on a source of pure velocity.

feats.scene: Reralllu runs through a defense drone at full speed and tears it in two.
Reralllu is hit by a laser salvo and keeps running before collapsing.
Reralllu crosses a city in a heartbeat.

reply.summary: Auiuium is a mechanically upgraded soldier in a band of hired killers who answered to a prophet's doom. Auiuium handles blades and guns well and falls with the rest of the squad.

feats.scene: Auiuium drives a blade through a plate door in a single lunge.
Auiuium keeps fighting after taking a rifle burst against his implants.

reply.summary: Lleseta is a fast enforcer for a brutal regime in a world where tyrants won a great war, powered by a force of pure velocity. Lleseta hunts dissidents while speeding between districts.

feats.scene: Lleseta slams through a barricade at full tilt and leaves a crater in the road.
Lleseta is thrown through a shopfront by a tank shell and rises scowling.
Lleseta crosses a district before the echo of a shout fades.

reply.summary: Staian is a blond adventuring speedster in a mirror world where traits are swapped, drawing on a wellspring of velocity. Staian runs with a team of champions and fights for the helpless.

feats.scene: Staian runs through a gang's barricade and scatters the wreckage across a street.
Staian skids on the pavement after a collision and stands up smiling.
Staian circles a block before her friends turn their heads.

reply.summary: Striaceo is a masked speedster in a parallel world's council whose true identity is a mystery even to allies. Striaceo moves with a blur through the streets of a metropolis.

feats.scene: Striaceo slams into a runaway truck at full speed and stops it cold.
Striaceo rolls through a collision with a bruised shoulder.
Striaceo vanishes from one rooftop and appears on another.

reply.summary: Rosorori is a blond streaker who coaches a young apprentice and sits on a team of costumed heroes. Rosorori is a daydream guest in a teenager's fantasy of joining the roster.

feats.scene: Rosorori sprints through a wall of boxes and sends them flying.
Rosorori skids across a floor and bounces up cheerfully.
Rosorori laps a tower in the blink of an eye.

reply.summary: Colnauori is a masked successor in a crossover world who runs fast and throws lightning, fighting beside legendary allies against a god-tier tyrant. Colnauori represents the next wave of defenders.

feats.scene: Colnauori streaks past a titan and strikes it with a lightning-charged fist.
Colnauori absorbs a stray cosmic blast and keeps running.
Colnauori crosses a battlefield between two heartbeats.

reply.summary: Linst is a grey-skinned, purple-eyed assassin who absorbs the skills of whoever has just died. Linst jokes about death with every strike and serves as a sidekick to a morbid master.

feats.scene: Linst throws a dagger through a dangling lantern chain and drops a chandelier on guards.
Linst takes a rifle stock to the jaw and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Ntunti is a pale, pink-eyed fighter obsessed with mortality since childhood who inherits the dead's knowledge and abilities. Ntunti turned white after an ambush at a burial and wanders the globe seeking more teachers.

feats.scene: Ntunti disarms an assassin and fells three more with stolen technique.
Ntunti stands through a barrage of fists in a tournament ring.

reply.summary: Tertauva is a genderless brute who serves as the personal minion of a chaos lord. Tertauva has extraordinary strength and a hide that turns blades, and it falls when its master does.

feats.scene: Tertauva hurls a boulder through a stone gate and shatters the arch.
Tertauva takes a siege-engine blow and remains on its feet.

reply.summary: Iartiu is a purple-skinned recruit who wore a yellow-lit ring and helped crush a rival police force. Iartiu forms constructs, projects blasts and flies on the ring's fear-powered charge.

feats.scene: Iartiu shapes a giant fist of yellow light and flattens a barricade of guards.
Iartiu raises a shield that holds against a point-blank cannon.

reply.summary: Stieru is a pink-skinned warrior from an empire of conquerors who joined a team of heroes to face a dark sorcerer. Stieru hits first and thinks later, fighting with brute force and a soldier's discipline.

feats.scene: Stieru slams a gauntlet through a bulkhead and drags a guard out.
Stieru is blasted off a gantry and rises with a grin.

reply.summary: Coton is a blinded fanatic who bought a strange helm to read minds, absorb energy and return it as a blast. Coton hunts a masked vigilante by baiting his friends with abductions and bombs.

feats.scene: Coton releases stored force from his helm and collapses the front of a building.
Coton takes a batarang volley and a fall through a skylight and keeps taunting.

reply.summary: Coriuia is the ringleader of a crew of unhinged crooks who steal a hero's weapon to terrorize a metropolis. Coriuia ends up behind bars when the hero reclaims it.

feats.scene: Coriuia fires the stolen gun and punches a hole through a brick wall.
Coriuia tumbles down a fire escape and keeps cackling.

reply.summary: Lurire is an underworld fighter coated in a slick substance that blades cannot pierce, hired to take down a sword-wielding heroine. Lurire holds a deep grudge for dead friends and is dropped through a floor on his own momentum.

feats.scene: Lurire kicks a steel door off its hinges.
Lurire laughs as a katana slides harmlessly across his skin.

reply.summary: Tirte is a blond double agent, daughter of a legendary spy, raised in a foreign household and trained to serve the wrong side. Tirte switches loyalties after witnessing atrocities and takes a bullet at a firing line to save an ally.

feats.scene: Tirte clubs a guard with a pistol butt and unlocks a cell.
Tirte survives a gunshot wound and a ferry ride to recovery.

reply.summary: Luvalmi is a lesser member of a villain alliance who flexes his bulk as a threat against a god-blooded hero. Luvalmi mostly hangs around the edges of bigger plots, offering muscle and little else.

feats.scene: Luvalmi lifts a vending machine and hurls it across an alley.
Luvalmi staggers up after a rooftop fall with a shrug.

reply.summary: Seoiasno is a laid-back, kind-hearted strongman who bends the world by flexing different muscles. Freed after decades of confinement, Seoiasno helps a ragtag family and still mourns a late spouse.

feats.scene: Seoiasno flexes a bicep and a whole street warps into a meadow.
Seoiasno bounces back from a tower collapse with a pleasant smile.

reply.summary: Seoliumil is a former beach weakling transformed by a mail-order training book into a muscular hero who can rewrite reality by flexing. Seoliumil wears leopard-print trunks and a halo of glowing letters, and trouble lurks below a government building.

feats.scene: Seoliumil flexes and the surrounding block briefly turns to candy.
Seoliumil walks through a wall of gunfire unbothered.

reply.summary: Tollian is a gym-running hero who lost his gift after torture and regained it watching old friends fight. Tollian leads a trainee squad and waits in a hidden bunker for the team to regroup.

feats.scene: Tollian flexes a thigh and a wall of steel peels into confetti.
Tollian is knocked across a field by a godlike foe and gets up to flex again.

reply.summary: Tiunttia is a red-eyed headhunter who recruits champions for a slave trade operating across space. Tiunttia scouts warriors, bargains with warlords and dreams of building a private empire.

feats.scene: Tiunttia fires a stun-lance and drops a hulking guard.
Tiunttia takes a point-blank blast on his armor and fires back.

reply.summary: Teorci is a blue-skinned interstellar peacekeeper who draws on will and a power ring to build constructs, fire blasts and fly. Teorci patrols mobile sectors and calls on a charging lantern for energy.

feats.scene: Teorci shapes a glowing wall and crushes a pirate cruiser's engine pod.
Teorci raises a ring shield and holds off a cannon volley.

reply.summary: Maiar is a hairless alien researcher stuck in a timeless place after its body was lost on first crossing. Maiar floats about as a leftover spirit, studying the strange realm alongside two friends.

feats.scene: Maiar nudges a loose instrument across a table with a pulse of will.
Maiar drifts through a collapsing lab and comes out unharmed.

reply.summary: Anronli is a green fish who dashes across a barnyard league of animal heroes. Anronli sprints at astonishing speed and is annoyed but unharmed by a rival's attempts at mental control.

feats.scene: Anronli dashes up and bumps a runaway egg out of a fox's path.
Anronli bounces off a frozen pond and shakes it off.
Anronli sprints across the pond in a flash.

reply.summary: Rnosor is a sentient cloud from a gas world, absorbed into a power ring and sworn to defend a sector. Rnosor spreads across an entire region to smother a mad deity and vanishes into the void.

feats.scene: Rnosor expands across a sector and crushes a rampaging deity by contracting.
Rnosor disperses into vapor under a cannon barrage and reforms unharmed.

reply.summary: Teltiuca is a white-eyed engineered weapon grown from a stolen embryo in deep space to overload the defenses of worlds. Teltiuca generates and drinks raw energy, flies between planets and wears light plating.

feats.scene: Teltiuca overloads the core of a small world and cracks it apart.
Teltiuca takes the blast of a planetary defense grid without a scratch.

reply.summary: Loval is a former prosecutor and elected city head who becomes a brain-craving undead and is cured moments before a fatal shot. Loval holds a walled-in population together through tension and ends dumped in a park.

feats.scene: Loval slams a gavel and a courtroom of murmurs falls silent.
Loval staggers through a street riot with torn sleeves.

reply.summary: Amlasle is a dark-haired mercenary marksman from a mirror timeline who was thought lost in an invasion. Amlasle was actually flung backward through time by a failed experiment and now lurks as a copycat sharpshooter.

feats.scene: Amlasle fires a rifle round that pierces a steel helmet across a courtyard.
Amlasle shrugs off a hard landing from a time rift.
